# Getting Started with RConsoleAI

RConsoleAI is an AI chatbot that works directly inside the R and RStudio Console. It requires no local models, no Ollama, and no API keys for basic usage.

## Installation

```r
# Install from GitHub
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("yourusername/rconsoleai")

# Load the package
library(rconsoleai)
```

## Your First Chat

Start an interactive chat session:

```r
rchat()
```

You'll see a welcome banner and can start chatting immediately:

```text
========================================
          RConsoleAI
      Your AI Programming Assistant
========================================

Provider: AI Horde
Model: Automatically selected
Status: Connected

Type /help for commands.
Type /exit to quit.

You: 
```

Try asking a question:

```
You: Explain the pnorm function in R.

RConsoleAI:
The `pnorm()` function in R calculates the cumulative distribution function (CDF) 
for the normal distribution...
```

## Single Prompt Mode

For quick questions without starting a full session:

```r
rchat("How do I do a t-test in R?")
```

## Slash Commands

During an interactive session, use these commands:

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/help` | Show available commands |
| `/exit`, `/quit` | End session |
| `/clear` | Clear conversation history |
| `/models` | List available models |
| `/model` | Show current model |
| `/model NAME` | Change model |
| `/provider` | Show current provider |
| `/provider horde` | Use AI Horde (free) |
| `/provider gateway` | Use secure backend |
| `/provider auto` | Auto-select provider |
| `/system` | Show system prompt |
| `/system TEXT` | Update system prompt |
| `/status` | Show connection info |
| `/retry` | Retry last request |
| `/save [file]` | Save conversation |
| `/load [file]` | Load conversation |
| `/history` | Show message history |
| `/context` | Show R environment |

## Configuration

View current settings:

```r
rchat_config()
```

Change defaults:

```r
rchat_config(
  provider = "auto",           # "horde", "gateway", or "auto"
  max_tokens = 700,            # Response length limit
  timeout = 90,                # Request timeout (seconds)
  history_limit = 50,          # Conversation history limit
  persist_history = TRUE,      # Save history between sessions
  color_output = TRUE,         # Colored console output
  gateway_url = NULL           # Your backend URL (optional)
)
```

## Provider Selection

RConsoleAI supports multiple AI providers:

### AI Horde (Default, Free)
- No API key required
- Community-run distributed inference
- Dynamic model discovery
- Queue times vary (10-60+ seconds)

```r
rchat_provider("horde")
```

### Secure Gateway (Optional)
Requires a deployed Cloudflare Worker backend for authenticated providers (NVIDIA Nemotron, OpenAI-compatible).

```r
rchat_config(gateway_url = "https://your-worker.your-subdomain.workers.dev")
rchat_provider("gateway")
```

### Auto Selection (Recommended)
Tries gateway first, falls back to AI Horde:

```r
rchat_provider("auto")
```

## R Programming Integration

RConsoleAI includes specialized functions for R development:

### Debug Code
```r
rchat_code("
x <- rnorm(100)
hist(x)
")
```

### Explain Code
```r
rchat_explain("
model <- lm(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
summary(model)
")
```

### Analyze Dataset
```r
rchat_data(mtcars)
rchat_data(iris, include_data = TRUE)  # With sample values
```

### Ask About Environment
```r
rchat_env("What data frames do I have loaded?")
rchat_env("What's in my dataframe df?", include_values = TRUE)
```

## Conversation Management

Conversations persist between sessions by default. Save/load manually:

```r
# Save
conv <- rchat()
# ... chat ...
rchat_save(conv, "my_chat.rds")

# Load later
conv2 <- rchat_load("my_chat.rds")
rchat(conversation = conv2)
```
